_comment: Paths the defensive-pattern checks do not apply to.
eslint-plugin-defensive: its rule definitions CONTAIN the patterns they describe.
scripts/__tests__: a test harness catches on purpose — it spawns the script under
test and asserts on the exit code and stderr, which requires catching the non-zero
exit. That is the harness doing its job, not production code swallowing an error.
The catches here do handle the error (they read e.status / e.stdout); EMPTY_CATCH's
awk line-tracking mis-attributes them to nearby assertion lines.
